_README: Authored seed overlay for tools/command-center/seed.py. Everything a machine can
derive from REGISTER.md (id, title, program, section, status, effort, evidence,
sources) is derived and is NOT repeated here. This file carries only the four
things the register states in prose but does not put in a column: dependency
edges, owner gates, security class, and the next smallest action.
Every edge below quotes the register text that asserts it. An edge that is not
asserted anywhere is NOT invented: a false dependency manufactures false
unreachability, which is the exact defect this catalog exists to detect.
